---
name: A defect
about: Something is wrong, not merely missing
labels: bug
---

<!-- One defect, one component. -->

## What is wrong

One sentence.

## The evidence

A command and its output, or the two lines of code that disagree. Not a
description of the bug — the thing that shows it. A measured number beats an
adjective.

## What it costs

How many rows, fights or players are affected, and since when if you can
tell.

## Why nothing caught it

Which instrument should have, and what it reported instead. If the answer is
"no instrument covers this", that is the more important half of the issue.
